flowRoot.flowPara: 4: Script Start, Turn Phases I & II
5: Turn Phase III, Death's Grasp, Death's Caress, Unquenched
6: Grave Smash, Carrion Spew, Welcoming Dead
Golgothon the Restless is a beginner level encounter for Boss Fight: Tactics Arena. It is tuned to be a good challenge for players who are new to the game.
This encounter pits the players against a "graveyard elemental" and its zombie minions. The primary challenges for the players are:

• the Death's Grasp / Death's Caress combo. Death's Grasp pulls the players to Golgothon, while Death's Caress (which is always cast the following turn) causes extreme damage to players who remain close. This would be a simple challenge, except...

• the Welcoming Dead minions spawned by Golgothon limit player movement, forcing the players to deal with the minions or risk being trapped within reach of Death's Caress. The minions themselves start as a minor threat, but...

• due to Unquenched, the battle increases in difficulty as it wears on. If the players are unable to defeat Golgothon, they will fall to the ever-growing horde of increasingly fast and deadly minions.
